name: vevil-system
description: Vevil: backend NestJS + frontend React. Desarrollo en PC con Postgres local; push → nube (Render + Vercel + Supabase).

scripts.dev: docker-compose up -d && npx wait-on -d 2000 -t 30000 tcp:localhost:5432 && concurrently -k -n be,fe "npx cross-env DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_USERNAME=postgres DB_PASSWORD=admin DB_DATABASE=vevil_db npm run start:dev --prefix backend-vevil" "npx cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/api npm run dev --prefix frontend-vevil"
scripts.dev:backend: npx cross-env DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_USERNAME=postgres DB_PASSWORD=admin DB_DATABASE=vevil_db npm run start:dev --prefix backend-vevil
scripts.dev:frontend: npx cross-env VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000/api npm run dev --prefix frontend-vevil
scripts.pre-deploy:local: npm run dev:up && npx wait-on -d 2000 -t 30000 tcp:localhost:5432 && npm run db:migrate && echo Listo. Ejecuta npm run dev y abre http://localhost:5173. Checklist en docs/PRE_DEPLOY_LOCAL_CHECK.md
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix backend-vevil && npm run build --prefix frontend-vevil
